subject: Re: Redwood demo / security & procurement alignment - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@finpath.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood discovery recap + next steps (technical deep dive / security)

Hi Sophie —

Great to meet today, and thanks for the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our discovery call: 

- Primary use case: real-time LLM-powered code suggestions within FinPath's developer portal (low single-digit token latency target, high throughput during batch syncs).
- Data sensitivity: customer PII in prompts; retention needs to be configurable per account.
- Procurement/security asks: SOC 2 attestation, KMS support, and a short security questionnaire (Rahul mentioned he'll handle).
- Success criteria for POC: <10% latency regression vs current baseline and clear unit-cost estimate for 1M tokens/month.

Next steps I propose:
1) Tech deep dive / demo with our SE (Aditya) to walk integration options, batching/kv-cache, and quantization trade-offs — 60 minutes.
2) Loop in Rahul (security) and your procurement contact to review the questionnaire and SOW draft.
3) Share a short agenda + SOW/security questionnaire ahead of the call.

Can you confirm who from your side should join the technical deep dive and share 2–3 time windows next week (PST preferred)?

I'll attach a draft SOW and our security questionnaire for Rahul to review.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0199
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: FinPath-SOW-draft.pdf (pdf)]
[Attachment: security-questionnaire-FinPath.xlsx (xlsx)]

Thanks Marissa — this is perfect, and thanks for the clear recap.

Attendees for the tech deep dive: myself, Rahul (security), and one engineer from our platform team (Priya, I’ll confirm her availability). Procurement is looped on this thread.

Our availability next week (EST):
- Tue 3/2: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:00
- Wed 3/3: 13:00–15:00

Rahul — can you take a first pass on the questionnaire and flag anything that looks like a blocker? Procurement team, if you prefer to meet separately about commercial terms we can do a short sync after the technical session.

Sophie Turner

sophie.turner@finpath.com | +1 212-555-0123

Subject: Re: Redwood discovery recap + next steps (technical deep dive / security)

Thanks Sophie — Tue 3/2 10:00 PST (13:00 EST) works well for our team. I’ve tentatively booked 60 minutes for the technical deep dive.

Aditya (SE) — can you run through the demo/technical agenda below?

Proposed agenda (60m):
- 5m quick intros and objectives
- 20m demo: real-time inference architecture + integration patterns
- 15m deep dive: batching, KV caching, and latency trade-offs for short prompts
- 10m security & compliance notes (hand-off to Rahul for detailed Qs)
- 10m next steps / POC success criteria

I attached the SOW draft and security questionnaire for Rahul/procurement to review before the call. If procurement prefers a separate commercial call, we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up.

Hi all — jumping in for the SE side. Thanks for scheduling, Marissa & Sophie.

Couple notes from the SE perspective:
- I’ll prepare two short demos: (1) a live integration using our hosted API showing latency and token usage, (2) a private deployment sketch showing KMS + data residency options.
- Please forward any representative prompt examples and peak concurrency data — those help me size batching and KV cache settings for the demo.
- Security agenda item: I’ll keep it high level (auth, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS integration). Rahul — happy to meet separately after the session to go line-by-line on the questionnaire.

Availability for follow-ups if you want a separate procurement/security call (all times PST):
- Tue 3/2 after 14:00
- Wed 3/3 09:00–12:00

Looking forward — I’ll drop the demo links and a calendar invite once we lock the final time.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com | (650) 555-0147
